svg.desc: and: sift 31,083, sift (positions off) 30,291, Elasticsearch 19,864, pg_search 2,640, pg_textsearch 165, rum 5,626, pgx-bm25 210; or: sift 10,159, sift (positions off) 9,115, Elasticsearch 12,658, pg_search 2,159, pg_textsearch 10,146, rum 55, pgx-bm25 170; phrase: sift 26,073, sift (positions off) 6,925, Elasticsearch 21,481, pg_search 2,444, pg_textsearch 190, rum 181, pgx-bm25 120; mixed: sift 15,893, sift (positions off) 10,689, Elasticsearch 16,254, pg_search 2,296, pg_textsearch 148, rum 106, pgx-bm25 125; count(*): sift 33,326, sift (positions off) 6,724, Elasticsearch 30,729, pg_search 2,387, pg_textsearch 236, rum 242, pgx-bm25 130; filter: sift 13,496, sift (positions off) 11,617, Elasticsearch 13,957, pg_search 2,139, pg_textsearch 155, rum 105, pgx-bm25 133; join: sift 7,362, sift (positions off) 4,328, Elasticsearch 16,163, pg_search 457, pg_textsearch 171, rum 98, pgx-bm25 138
svg.text: queries per second, higher is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP; its join is a term filter on a denormalized region field.
Simple English Wikipedia, 50,000 articles, 8 clients, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 11-12); Oct 2026.
